title: armeria maritima var. macloviana
intro: Armeria maritima var. macloviana, commonly known as Sea Thrift, is a plant species within the Plumbaginaceae family. It is a low-growing, evergreen perennial with white or pink flowers, often used in rock gardens and coastal areas for its ornamental value. The Sea Thrift plant has been traditionally used to promote wound healing and reduce inflammation, attributed to its health benefits in treating minor cuts and burns. The bioactive constituents of Sea Thrift include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are known to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
